cause: Under the strict tick the workflow start and the activity schedule share one virtual instant. The server caps the activity's ScheduleToClose at the 3s run timeout, so the activity deadline equals the run expiration, and CreateNextActivityTimer skips an activity timer only when it is strictly after the run expiration. The ActivityTimeoutTask and the WorkflowRunTimeoutTask then carry the same visibility timestamp and the seeded schedule picks the order. When the activity task runs first the activity is closed as timed out, the workflow closes with no pending activity, and no WorkerCommandsTask is generated. The command is never created, so no budget can deliver it.

proposed_correction.recommended: Run TestWorkerCommandsTaskSuite under clock_tick forward in tests.generator.json and remove the skip after verification
alternatives: Test owner: schedule the activity one second into the run (fn105-d18-variant-b-test.diff.txt)
History service owner, with production review: skip the activity timer when its deadline equals the run expiration (fn105-d18-variant-c-server.diff.txt)
